newsitem.title: USA: American Vanguard to purchase Zeneca unit business.
newsitem.headline: American Vanguard to purchase Zeneca unit business.

text.p: American Vanguard Corp on Wednesday said they have agreed to purchase the North American soil fumigant business from Zeneca Inc, a wholly-owned unit of Zeneca Group PLC.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed, but Zeneca said the transaction will represent less than one percent of Zeneca Group net assets.
The fumigant, named Vapam, is based on the active ingredient metam sodium. AMVAC also manufactures metam sodium, which it markets as Metam 426.
Zeneca currently produces Vapam at its Richmond, California manufacturing facility, which will not be a part of the sale agreement.
Zeneca and American expect to close the sale by the end of 1996.
